proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C hABC hiso
  have hb := EuclideanGeometry.angle_eq_angle_of_dist_eq hiso
  have hs := EuclideanGeometry.angle_add_angle_add_angle_eq_pi C (ne₁₂_of_not_collinear hABC).symm
  have hp : 0 < EuclideanGeometry.angle B A C :=
    EuclideanGeometry.angle_pos_of_not_collinear (by rwa [Set.insert_comm])
  rw [EuclideanGeometry.angle_comm B C A, ← hb, EuclideanGeometry.angle_comm C A B] at hs
  constructor <;> linarith
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C : P), ¬Collinear ℝ ({A, B, C} : Set P) → dist A B = dist A C → EuclideanGeometry.angle A B C < Real.pi / 2 ∧ EuclideanGeometry.angle B A C = Real.pi - 2 * EuclideanGeometry.angle A B C
